text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Yes, yes...!! I'm feeling good 
about this...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I've become able to run this well...!
(WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Calm down. ...Smile, stay cheerful, 
bright, and cute!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Everyooone!! Thanks for waaatcthing!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko 
Tarumae!! Please keep rooting for 
Tomakomai and for me from here on out, 
okay—?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, that girl's a local idol? Her 
running was incredible—she's definitely 
one to watch!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You've held a solo event in Tomakomai 
before? You're a legit local idol then, 
wow. That's pretty unique~

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Locodol...? Guess that's like an Umadol. 
...Reminds me of Smart Falcon. I wonder if 
that girl will hit the big time just like 
her.

Having delivered a magnificent result, 
Hokko Tarumae came back to me with an 
expression overflowing with a sense of 
accomplishment...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—It was incredible! I could really feel 
the crowd watching me like never 
before...!
choice_data_list:
It just means you were able to run that 
well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Maybe this will help lots of 
people take a look at Tomakomai...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Congratulations, Tarumae! That was an 
amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ricky!? You went out of your way to come 
watch me... !?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. The signs showed there'd be an omen 
in today's race! And seeing it in person 
proved it totally right!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae's running was truly incredible. 
Her qi was firmer and stronger than ever 
before—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when you were calling out to the 
audience, you were truly shining. Your 
passion to share Tomakomai's charms 
completely shifted the atmosphere of the 
room.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What I'm currently lacking as a fresh 
debutante... I feel like I got a hint 
today about what I need to strive for!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll work harder and harder in dirt races 
to share Feng Shui with everyone, too! So—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Go on ahead and wait for me, okay? I'll 
catch up in no time with feng shui power☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey... Thank you for celebrating with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Don't rely too much on feng shui, 
though—make sure you train seriously, 
okay? The racing world isn't that 
forgiving!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Aww, that part hasn't changed at all~☆

After safely completing the Leopard 
Stakes, a few days had passed since 
returning to the training camp—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Hrrrm...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Thanks for your hard work.
choice_data_list: Were you updating your social media?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I also did some vanity searching on 
the side, comparing my view counts and 
everything before and after the Leopard 
Stakes, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It seems that race really did introduce 
me to a lot of new people."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My followers have shot up, and there are 
so many more replies to my new posts...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For example, the number of shares on 
photos during training has been going up—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Also, videos pushing idol elements— 
focused mainly on singing and dancing— are 
getting a massive number of views!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Just—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...The posts sharing info about Tomakomai 
haven't really seen much difference in 
reaction compared to the others."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...What I really want everyone to see most 
is Tomakomai, though.

Curious, I quickly checked the shift in 
engagement on posts using my device. 
Indeed, Tomakomai's PR updates didn't show 
as notable a change compared to the 
others.

However, it's definitely not like nothing 
has changed. The other genres are just 
exceptionally prominent; the number of 
people viewing Tomakomai's updates is 
steadily increasing too.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure they'll start paying attention to 
you from now on.

text_block_list.text:
If she continues to make great strides in 
her races, even if the change is small 
right now, it will surely reach countless 
people one day.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I hope so, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, in regards to this matter... 
there's something I'd like to consult you 
about.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Could you make the Champions Cup my next 
target race?

"True to its name, the Champions Cup is a 
GⅠ race where the strongest gather to 
contest the dirt division's crown."

"...The way Hokko Tarumae is now, she 
could reasonably set her sights on the 
challenge. However—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I know. I know it's going to be a very 
tough race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Because the Champions Cup is a race with 
Senior Class runners... Acute-san and the 
others will be running—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But... no, that's precisely why! I must 
take on the challenge right now!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely because all eyes are on me 
now! I want to take on even bigger 
challenges, deliver results, and make even 
greater strides...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, I'm sure... this time for 
real...! Everyone will notice not just me, 
but Tomakomai too...!

...Deep within her eyes burned an 
undeniable flame. A flame like an active 
volcano, ready to erupt at any moment.

Faced with such strong determination from 
her, how could I, as her Trainer, ever 
stand in the way of her progress—
choice_data_list:
—Let's take on the front lines of dirt 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

Hokko Tarumae has faced difficult 
challenges before and overcome them all. I 
resolved to believe in the strength her 
journey had forged.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll... definitely 
show you results!!

Toward the radiant pinnacle stage of the 
Champions Cup, they began moving forward 
with steadfast resolve...!
